text_block_list.text:
The days of relentless training continued 
in preparation for next year's Classic 
circuit.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah, haah! Phew, phew...
choice_data_list: Alright, shall we take a break for...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: All right, let's take a quick break.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! I'm off to take a break!

"...Ever since I started training with 
Dantsu Flame, there was something that 
began to weigh on my mind."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
After this,
we take a short break and then 
do one more set, right?
choice_data_list: No, next up is lower-body strength...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Got it! While taking a breather, I'll go 
look for an open machine!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The training menu for next week and 
beyond! Wow, I'm so glad~

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Mm-hmm, yeah, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Um... Nothing in particular from my 
end. Thank you very much!

"It means that despite entering her 'peak 
period,' her growth in ability remains 
sluggish."

The Awakening—
an Umamusume who experiences 
this will see an explosive surge in her 
athletic abilities.

Most Umamusume,
upon reaching their growth 
peak, run in the Debut Selection races 
aiming to secure a trainer contract and 
make their debut.

Dantsu Flame had already begun her growth 
spurt and should be right in the middle
of 
it... and yet, her growth curve was 
surprisingly gentle.

It was only a slight concern,
but... in my 
conversations with Dants Flame, I somehow 
felt a lack of personal will from her.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. Even when you say someone's 
reached their peak, there's quite a wide 
spectrum.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Besides, from what I can see, there's no 
need to panic yet.
Why don't we adjust the 
training regimen a bit... and see how 
things go for a little longer?
—A few days later.
choice_data_list: Hmm... Yeah, you've got a point.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer! Over here, over here! I found a 
great spot!"

I came to watch a graded stakes race
where 
both Agnes Tachyon and Jungle Pocket were 
competing.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, I've heard the rumors. You really 
pulled off quite a stunner in your debut 
race, didn't ya, Tachyon?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Pokke-kun! I've been dying to see 
you! I heard the news—
you're undefeated so 
far, right?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me in detail about your 
physical condition back then.
I've already 
recorded the track conditions, the 
weather, and data on your opponents, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa... Don't go acting so cocky, 
Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
My undefeated streak continues today. 
Today, I'm the one who's gonna crush you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? You... want me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahahahaha! Splendid, that will make for 
valuable data!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The hell did you say, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Man, those two are really burning with 
passion...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Loading into the gates proceeds
smoothly. 
A race that will divine the future of
next 
year's Classic Triple Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
All runners loaded into the gates. And 
they're off!

"The race progressed at a slow pace.
Agnes 
Tachyon bided her time in mid-pack. Then, 
right as they entered the final stretch—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Agnes Tachyon from the
outside! 
Agnes Tachyon takes the lead!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fufu—Hahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Is Jungle Pocket moving up to second?! 
――She's so strong! Agnes Tachyon remains 
in the lead!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Daaammiiiit!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Jungle Pocket is in second!
Agnes Tachyon 
takes a comfortable victory and crosses 
the finish line!"
(WOOOOO...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
2:00.8!? That's a new record! No way 
that's junior-class level!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Jungle Pocket set a course record 
too!? Man, I am seriously hyped for next 
year's Classic circuit~!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible!!

A thunderous wave of applause erupts 
across the racecourse in response to a 
battle that surpassed all expectations.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ――I will definitely defeat you!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, "the strongest" 
belongs to me! If you're on top,
I'll just 
climb even higher!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So... damn it, let's settle once and for 
all—! who's really stronger right here, 
right now...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...— Heh, heh heh heh...! Ahahahaha, 
hahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Who's stronger?" ...Haven't we just 
settled that in black and white?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Is what I'd like to say, but... I see, I 
see. Very well! —You are in luck.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I accept that challenge.
I'll be expecting 
great things, so do your best to keep up.

Raw fighting spirit,
fierce enough to give 
you goosebumps.

Intersecting, clashing, fierce sparks 
flying— That rising heat could be felt 
right in the middle of the race. Watching 
that scene, a thought crosses my mind.
Could Dantsu Flame do the same thing too?
...... I might not... be able to do it.

Dantsu Flame rarely speaks her mind. She 
doesn't really express her feelings 
openly.

I understand there's no ill intent. That 
sort of thing poses no problem at all in 
daily life—

"If anything,
it was an action born out of 
consideration for the other person, which 
can work quite well as a strong point."

Come to think of it, right after I first 
met and scouted Dants Flame, there was a 
period where I completely misunderstood 
her too.

I had vastly underestimated what being
the 
"protagonist" meant to Dantsu Flame.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...An Umamusume meant to take "center 
stage" doesn't lose in selection races.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I still... haven't shown that I can 
become the 'leading lady'."

What if this brings about a bad result
for 
Dants Flame...?

For instance... if holding back prevents 
excitement from building up,
which in turn 
leads to a slump in growth—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Haaah! I got way too excited, and now I'm 
kinda hungry.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go grab a bite to eat. Is 
there anything specific you want to eat?
choice_data_list: (Is it really something I should say?)
(Is it really something I should say?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, I want to eat ramen too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...? Yes! It's... really true, you know?

While such thoughts crossed my mind, I 
couldn't quite bring myself to point it 
out.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: U-Um? What's the matter~?

There might be another reason for her 
plateauing. It could be the training 
regimen, or it might be a physical 
constitution issue. Above all—

Before I could point out the gentle 
demeanor ingrained in her as a flaw, I 
needed just a little more certainty.
